The failure is // coloured by a badge and never by a text colour on the row, so it survives // every style and stays readable to anyone who cannot see the hue. // // The five rows are written out rather than mapped. Each state carries // something different (a badge here, a spinner there), so a data driven version // needs a switch in the row body and reads worse than the markup it replaces. // // The spinner sits inside the icon slot, which the primitive hides from // assistive tech together with its subtree, so its own status role never // reaches the accessibility tree.
